title: Countdown Into Neon Night
tests: Checks a visible descending countdown, synchronized musical buildup, and a readable event reveal rather than a static promo.

faults.what: The supplied audio transcription reports speech, contrary to the explicit no-talking requirement.
The countdown still shows 1 at 5 seconds, leaving less than the required 3 seconds for the complete final card.

judge.summary: The vertical neon ad has a clear countdown and correct event text, but includes unwanted speech and reveals the final card too late.

must_haves.item: The video is 8 seconds long in 9:16.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 8 seconds and the frames have 9:16 vertical proportions.

must_haves.item: Large numerals appear in the order '3', '2', '1', followed by the event reveal.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show large 3, 2 and 1 numerals in order, then the event card.

must_haves.item: Electronic music builds during the countdown, with audible accents matching the numeral changes.
must_haves.why: The audio description supplies speech and peak level, but no evidence of music style, build or synchronized accents.

must_haves.item: Neon lighting or graphics visibly change during the countdown.
must_haves.why: The cyan and pink streaks visibly vary in shape and brightness between countdown frames.

must_haves.item: The final card shows 'Neon Night', '12 September 2026' and 'The Foundry, Leeds' together for at least 3 seconds, without clipped text.
must_haves.why: All three lines are legible and unclipped at 7 seconds, but the numeral 1 remains at 5 seconds, preventing a full 3-second end-card hold within the 8-second clip.
The supplied sound transcription explicitly reports speech: "පෙම්වතුන්."
